model.name: GPT-6 Astra
model.positioning: Generational leap in agentic computer use; OpenAI leadership framed it as the start of the 'AGI era'.

claim_legend.openai_claim: Stated by OpenAI (marketing or system card); not independently verified at launch.
claim_legend.reported: Reported by multiple outlets covering the launch.
claim_legend.commentary: Analysis / opinion, not a sourced fact.

capabilities.headline: State-of-the-art computer use — operates apps and browsers like a human and completes multi-step tasks.
examples: Form completion and CRM record updates
Calendar organisation and multi-site web research
capabilities.reasoning: Reported to have helped solve long-standing open problems in mathematics (openai_claim).
capabilities.codex_change: Keeps notes across context windows instead of compressing sessions into lossy summaries.

benchmarks.note: Headline figures are OpenAI's rounded marketing numbers. Detailed table values differ. Methodology and harness vary by vendor.

detailed_table_reported.OSWorld_2_0_offline_subset: 72.6% at ~40 min/task vs GPT-5.6 Sol 65.7% at ~75 min/task

caveats: ARC-AGI-3 ~99.9% relies on an expensive stateful agent harness (Responses API loop); stateless API scores are much lower.
'Saturates' means the benchmark is exhausted, not that the capability is complete.
GDPval (OpenAI's 1,320-task real-world economic-work benchmark) was NOT published at launch.
Astra uses fewer reasoning tokens and 'opaque recurrence', reducing chain-of-thought monitorability.

safety.preparedness_framework: First model designated at the 'Critical' cybersecurity threshold.
safety.critical_meaning: Can identify previously unknown vulnerabilities without continuous human guidance.
safety.eval_findings: Reportedly discovered 2 previously unknown vulnerabilities during evaluation.
safety.incident_context: OpenAI added safeguards after a Hugging Face breach during the run-up to release.
safety.advanced_cyber_access: Gated behind the Daybreak program (approved orgs only).

leadership_quotes.greg_brockman: Welcome to the AGI era / I do think we're there
leadership_quotes.jakub_pachocki: Progress in intelligence does not guarantee progress in alignment

access.rollout_timing: Limited orgs at launch; broader ChatGPT + API + cloud 'over the coming days'.
access.daybreak_program: Live for approved orgs (advanced cyber features).

pricing_usd_per_1m_tokens.context: Standard rate is roughly 10x typical mid-tier model pricing. A 200K-in / 50K-out run costs ~$4.50 standard.

training.scale_claim: OpenAI's largest training run to date (openai_claim).
training.infra: First model pretrained using >100,000 DBUs on Stargate infrastructure.
training.supervision: Previous OpenAI models played major supervisory roles in training.
